name: Cocoteo FM
summary: An in-game radio station playing modern Latin music, hosted by El Martillo and La Gata.
body: GameSpot and The Big Lead report that El Martillo is Bad Bunny and La Gata is RaiNao. Rockstar's own pages give only the character names.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Bad Bunny - EoO; Romeo Santos ft. El Chaval de la Bachata - Canalla; Axel Rulay ft. Farruko and El Alfa - Si Es Trucho Es Trucho (Remix); Myke Towers - Girl; Young Miko - Ni Le Cabe; Bad Bunny - Otra Noche en Miami; Chimbala & Omega - Se Me Nota (Agarrame); Don Omar - Intocable; Fuerza Regida - Suzuki; Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000; Tainy & Bad Bunny - Mojabi Ghost; Calle 13 - Suave Mix (Blass Remix).

name: Back Country Radio
summary: An in-game radio station playing renegade country, hosted by MW and Delta Dawne.
body: Rockstar also names Mud Dog Mike, the station's roving reporter and swamp meteorologist, who checks in from his Grassrivers airboat.
GameSpot, CULTR and NME report that MW is Morgan Wallen, Delta Dawne is Lana Del Rey and Mud Dog Mike is Jeremy Dufrene. Rockstar's own pages give only the character names.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: David Allan Coe - Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior; Glen Campbell - Rhinestone Cowboy; Mel McDaniel - Louisiana Saturday Night; George Strait - The Fireman; Loretta Lynn - Don't Come Home A-Drinkin' (With Lovin' On Your Mind); Hank Williams Jr. ft. Waylon Jennings - The Conversation; Tony Joe White - Polk Salad Annie; The Kentucky Headhunters - Walk Softly On This Heart of Mine.

name: AfroBank FM
summary: An in-game radio station playing amapiano, African classics and 3-step, hosted by Burna and Palmsy.
body: GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead report that Burna is Burna Boy and Palmsy is the DJ and producer Palms Trax.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Tony Allen & The Afro Messengers - No Discrimination; Alafia - Assanssan; Uncle Waffles - Wadibusa; Asake - Joha; Pat Thomas ft. Ebo Taylor - Gye Wani; DJ Lag & Robot Boii ft. Kamo Mphela - Shay'sana; Hugh Masekela - Run No More; Manu Dibango - Goro City.

name: The Chamber
summary: An in-game radio station playing metal, hosted by DJ Kerry and DJ Tom.
body: Rockstar's music page labels it The Chamber. The preview clip on the same page is named The Chamber 106.6.
GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead report that DJ Kerry and DJ Tom are Slayer's Kerry King and Tom Araya.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Slayer - Raining Blood; Black Sabbath - I; Pantera - I'm Broken; Megadeth - Symphony of Destruction; Metallica - Master of Puppets; Mastodon - Blood and Thunder; Anthrax - I Am The Law; Metallica - Battery; Metallica - Seek & Destroy; Sepultura - Territory; System of a Down - Sugar; TOOL - Sober; Overkill - Rotten to the Core.

name: Flash FM
summary: An in-game radio station playing pop, hosted by Robyn and Alex. Rockstar bills it as a Vice City institution.
body: GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead report that the hosts are the singer Robyn and the model Alex Consani.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: Charli XCX - Good Ones; MGMT - Electric Feel; Zara Larsson and PinkPantheress - Midnight Sun; Ciara and Justin Timberlake - Love Sex Magic; Kylie Minogue - Spinning Around; Drake - Hold On, We're Going Home; X-Press 2 ft. David Byrne - Lazy; Addison Rae - Fame Is a Gun; Katseye - Gabriela; Ariana Grande - Break Free; Chappell Roan - Hot To Go!; Dua Lipa - Houdini; Billie Eilish - Lunch; Gorillaz - Dare; Daft Punk - Around the World.
GameSpot's list for this station runs to more than thirty songs.

name: Dirty South Classics
summary: An in-game radio station playing regional rap and hip-hop classics, hosted by Trick and Trina.
body: GameSpot, CULTR and The Big Lead report that the hosts are the Miami rappers Trick Daddy and Trina.

Songs GameSpot reports hearing on it: David Banner ft. Lil' Flip - Like a Pimp; JT Money ft. Solé - Who Dat; DJ Khaled ft. Trick Daddy, Rick Ross and Pitbull - Born N Raised; Juvenile ft. Soulja Slim - Slow Motion; Petey Pablo - Freek-A-Leek; Trick Daddy - I'm a Thug; Young Buck - Shorty Wanna Ride; Lil Wayne - A Milli; Chingy ft. Ludacris & Snoop Dogg - Holidae Inn; Dem Franchize Boyz - White Boy; Birdman ft. Lil Wayne - Pop Bottles; Outkast - Players Ball; 2Pac ft. Trick Daddy - Still Ballin'; Shawty Lo - Dew Know.
